name: Leg Curl
instructions: Set the machine so your knees line up with the pivot and the pad rests just above your heels.
Lie or sit as the machine requires and grip the handles.
Curl your heels toward your glutes.
Squeeze your hamstrings at the end.
longevityNotes: Pulling strength balances all the forward-reaching of daily life and protects the shoulders and upper back. A strong back is one of the best predictors of staying active and independent.
overview: A machine hamstring curl that isolates the back of the thighs.

safetyNotes: Use a moderate weight; stop if you feel cramping or a sharp pain in the hamstring.
